one_line: Yashodharman, the Malwa ruler who checked Huna power, facing Mihirakula, the fierce Huna king, at the turning point of Huna dominance in northwestern India.

appearance.age_look: Both appear in their early 30s, athletic and battle-hardened; Yashodharman with a balanced warrior-king build, Mihirakula slightly leaner but wiry and tense.
appearance.face: Yashodharman has an oval face, medium-brown complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard, calm but intense eyes with a steady determined expression; Mihirakula has a slightly longer face, lighter wheat-brown complexion, high cheekbones, prominent nose, narrow dark eyes with a perpetual scowl and a thin moustache with short stubble, giving a harsh, hawk-like expression.
appearance.hair: Yashodharman’s black hair is tied into a high warrior topknot (small bun) at the back crown, with a few controlled strands framing his temples and a simple narrow gold circlet with a central red stone resting low on the forehead; Mihirakula’s dark brown hair is shoulder-length, rough and uneven, brushed back from the forehead and partly held by a plain dark leather headband that sits just above his brow.
appearance.costume: Yashodharman wears a mid-6th-century Malwa royal-warrior outfit: a long-sleeved, knee-length cotton tunic in deep saffron-orange with a subtle woven diamond pattern, belted at the waist with a broad dark-red cloth sash, over which sits a fitted brown leather belt with a simple bronze buckle; over his shoulders he has a sleeveless, thigh-length quilted vest of muted olive-green, lightly padded like an early brigandine, with small stitched squares and simple bronze rivet heads along the edges; his lower body is covered by off-white, narrow churidar-style trousers tucked into sturdy mid-calf brown leather boots with a slightly pointed toe and lacing at the front; he wears a long, soft cream-coloured cotton angavastra draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back, edged with a thin maroon border; jewellery is restrained—a short gold necklace with a small round pendant, a pair of simple gold stud earrings, and a single broad bronze armlet on his right upper arm; Mihirakula wears a steppe-influenced Huna war outfit: a long-sleeved, knee-length woolen kaftan in dull steel-grey, cross-wrapped and fastened on the right side with leather ties, reinforced with horizontal stitching at the chest; over this he has a sleeveless dark-brown leather lamellar cuirass made of overlapping rectangular plates sewn onto leather backing, extending to mid-thigh; his lower garment is a pair of slightly baggy dark-indigo trousers tucked firmly into thick dark-brown riding boots that reach just below the knee with visible stitching and a folded cuff at the top; around his waist is a wide black leather war belt with metal studs and a small hanging knife sheath; over his shoulders he wears a heavy, weathered wool cloak in dull charcoal, clasped at the right shoulder with an iron brooch, sometimes thrown back to reveal the armour; his jewellery is minimal, limited to a rough iron ring on his left hand and a string of small dark beads at his neck.
appearance.signature: Yashodharman’s signature weapon is a straight double-edged iron longsword with a simple cross-guard and slightly flared pommel, sheathed in a dark-brown leather scabbard hanging from his belt on his left hip, while Mihirakula’s is a recurved steppe-style composite bow of dark wood with horn reinforcements, carried in a plain leather bowcase on his left and a cylindrical quiver of red-brown leather with iron-capped arrows at his right hip.

ref_desc: Yashodharman has a medium-brown oval face, black topknot with a gold circlet, saffron tunic with olive quilted vest, cream angavastra and brown boots with a straight iron longsword, while Mihirakula has a lighter hawk-like face, rough shoulder-length dark hair with leather headband, steel-grey kaftan, dark leather lamellar cuirass, indigo trousers, charcoal cloak and a recurved composite bow with red-brown quiver.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two opposing 6th-century Indian figures standing side by side: on the left, Yashodharman, a medium-brown skinned Malwa ruler with an oval face, calm intense eyes, black hair tied in a high warrior topknot and a narrow gold circlet with a red stone, a neat moustache and short beard, wearing a long-sleeved knee-length deep saffron-orange cotton tunic with subtle woven diamond pattern, belted by a dark-red cloth sash and a brown leather belt, over which sits a sleeveless thigh-length olive-green quilted vest with stitched squares and small bronze rivets; he has off-white narrow churidar trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots, a cream cotton angavastra with maroon edging draped from his left shoulder across the chest, simple gold stud earrings, a short gold necklace, a bronze armlet on his right upper arm, and a straight double-edged iron longsword in a dark-brown leather scabbard hanging at his left hip. On the right, Mihirakula, a lighter wheat-brown skinned Huna king with a longer hawk-like face, narrow dark eyes in a harsh scowl, thin moustache and stubble, rough shoulder-length dark brown hair pushed back by a plain dark leather headband, wearing a long-sleeved knee-length steel-grey wool kaftan cross-wrapped and tied on the right, covered by a sleeveless dark-brown leather lamellar cuirass of overlapping plates reaching mid-thigh, dark-indigo slightly baggy trousers tucked into thick dark-brown knee-height riding boots with stitched details, a wide black leather war belt with metal studs, a dull charcoal wool cloak clasped at the right shoulder and thrown partly back, a rough iron ring and simple bead necklace, carrying a recurved steppe-style composite bow of dark wood with horn reinforcement in a leather bowcase at his left and a red-brown leather cylindrical quiver of iron-capped arrows at his right; show both characters front-facing in neutral but tense heroic poses, clearly displaying their faces, hair, full costumes and signature weapons with flat, clean colours dominated by saffron-orange, deep red, olive-green, steel-grey and dark brown.
